requirements.text: api-agent-gateway-gate.yml runs `python -m unittest ... tests.api_agent.test_director_learning_context`; that module defines 7 module-level pytest functions (tmp_path fixture) and no TestCase, so unittest collects 0 of them (the 7 tests it reports belong to an imported TestCase module). master-monday-preflight-gate.yml runs `python -m unittest ... tests.orchestration.test_consumer_receipt`; 8 module-level pytest functions are never collected (only the one TestCase test runs). Make each gate execute these tests for real (run the affected modules with pytest, or convert them to unittest.TestCase with tempfile fixtures as PR #1096 did for test_director_situation_room_shadow) and make the gate fail if the collected count for those modules is zero.
Gate logs show the 7 director-learning-context tests and 8 consumer-receipt module tests executing and passing.
A deliberately failing assertion in either module fails its gate.
Other modules in both gate steps still run.
No test assertion is removed or weakened.
No workflow trigger, schedule or permission changes.

market gates | model weights | canonical authority | portfolio logic | API budget | new policy semantics | historical artifact rewrite | threshold or anchor changes | workflow schedule or trigger changes | paid CFGI or OpenAI execution

evidence: PR #1260 merged at 4b82f0efdbb66aaa1154c50246158a0dde997f18 and changed only the candidate transition receipt plus the two in-scope test modules; no production script or workflow file changed.
API Agent Gateway Gate run 35924007914 executed all seven DirectorLearningContextUnittestCollectionTests by name and finished 97 tests PASS, while other gateway modules continued to execute.

Master Monday Preflight Gate run 35924007972 executed all eight ConsumerReceiptModuleFunctionCollectionTests by name and finished 31 tests PASS, while the existing invariant and other preflight modules continued to execute.

The compatibility wrappers call each original test function directly and contain no AssertionError/exception swallowing; therefore an underlying failing assertion propagates to unittest and fails the existing gate command.
